/** A declaration corpus with nested objects, imports, classes, and type operators. */
import type { Input, Output as Response } from "./contracts";
import DefaultClient, * as platform from "./platform";
export { DefaultClient as Client };
export type { Input };
export * from "./shared";

export type Id = string & { readonly brand: unique symbol };
export type State = "ready" | "working" | "complete";
export type Route = `/api/${string}/items/${number}`;
export type Escaped = "two  spaces, // not a comment, and \"quoted\"";
export type Tuple = readonly [name: string, count?: number, ...flags: boolean[]];
export type Indexed<Value> = Value[keyof Value];
export type Conditional<Value> = Value extends Promise<infer Item> ? Item : never;
export type Mapped<Value> = { readonly [Key in keyof Value as `get${Capitalize<string & Key>}`]?: Value[Key] };
export type Callback = <Value extends Input>(value: Value, index: number) => Promise<Response>;
export type Constructable = new (name: string, options?: Map<string, [number, boolean]>) => ClientInstance;

export interface Request<Value extends Input = Input> {
    /** The original object must survive formatting unchanged. */
    readonly value: Value;
    label?: string;
    [key: `metadata-${string}`]: unknown;
    nested: {
        readonly identifier: Id;
        response: Promise<{ status: number; payload: Value | null }>;
        callback(value: Value, context: Map<string, [number, boolean]>): void;
    };
    send(value: Value, headers: Map<string, string>, callback: (error: Error | null, result: Response) => void): Promise<Response>;
    send(value: Value): Promise<Response>;
    new (value: Value): Request<Value>;
    (value: Value, index?: number): Response;
}

interface Base { readonly id: Id; }
export interface Extended extends Base, Request<Input> {
    readonly [index: number]: Input;
    readonly enabled: boolean;
}

export enum Status {
    /** No request is in progress. */
    Idle,
    Active,
    Complete,
}

export abstract class ClientInstance<Value extends Input> implements Base {
    readonly id: Id;
    protected values: Map<string, Value>;
    private state: State;
    static readonly version: string;
    abstract send(request_identifier: Value, response_callback: (response: Response, index: number) => void): Promise<Response>;
    constructor(readonly name: string, protected options: Map<string, [number, boolean]>);
    get size(): number;
    set enabled(value: boolean);
    dispose(): void;
}

declare const registry: Map<string, ClientInstance<Input>>;
declare let current: State;
declare var fallback: Input | undefined;
export declare function create<Value extends Input>(request_identifier: Value, client_options: Map<string, [number, boolean]>, completion_callback: (response: Response, elapsed: number) => void): ClientInstance<Value>;
export function lookup(name: string): ClientInstance<Input> | undefined;

export namespace Protocol {
    export type Header = readonly [name: string, value: string];
    export interface Envelope<Value> {
        headers: Header[];
        payload: Value;
        retry?: { delay: number; limit: number };
    }
    export function decode<Value>(source: string, decoder: (text: string) => Value): Envelope<Value>;
}

declare module "external-plugin" {
    export interface Settings {
        enabled: boolean;
        pattern: `${string}:${number}`;
    }
    export function install(options: Settings): void;
}

/**
 * Keep an intentionally long documentation paragraph intact while reflowing the lines to the selected declaration width.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const example = "a long literal with // comment markers and  double spaces that is documentation only";
 * ```
 */
export function documented(request_identifier: string, registry_identifier: Map<string, Request<Input>>, response_callback: (result: Response) => void): void;
